_note: 量測數字（進版控的出處，speech_ai/CLAUDE.md 4.8）。w06-data.json 是 make_figs_w06.py 算出來的、每次重產；量測的放這裡。

subset.source: W5 Demo 1: LibriSpeech dev-clean, 40 speakers × 10 sentences (CC BY 4.0)

definitions.usage_ratio: distinct codes seen on the whole subset ÷ V, per stage
definitions.H1_norm: unigram entropy of the stage's codes (bits) ÷ log2 V; perplexity = 2^H1
definitions.repeat_rate: P(c_t = c_{t-1}) over within-sentence adjacent frames; mean_run = frames ÷ runs
definitions.H2_bits: plug-in H(c_t | c_{t-1}) over within-sentence adjacent pairs; H2_shuffled = the same after shuffling each sentence (small-sample bias)
definitions.residual.ratios[i-1]: Σ_t‖z_t − Σ_{j≤i} q_{t,j}‖² ÷ Σ_t‖z_t‖² over the whole subset; z and q in the quantizer's own space (EnCodec 128-d encoder output; Mimi after each path's input_proj, semantic and acoustic separately; DAC 1024-d with out_proj)
definitions.budget.text: tokens of one measured sentence ÷ its seconds × 1800 s (Gemma 4 tokenizer); extrapolated from one sentence

mandarin.text: 我想訂一張下週三去台南的票

english.text: Mister quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel.

definitions.bitrate_bps: f_r · n_q · log2 V with f_r and V read from the loaded config; frame_rate_measured = T / seconds
definitions.snr_db: waveform SNR (phase-sensitive; near 0 dB is normal for GAN-trained codecs)
definitions.f0_rmse_hz: RMSE of autocorrelation F0 on frames voiced in both original and reconstruction
definitions.voicing_agree: fraction of frames with the same voiced/unvoiced decision
definitions.what_we_heard: filled by hand after rehearsal (see w06.qmd p30/p31)
